10000.name: Cloudfrost's Edge
10000.des:
A weapon forged by a legendary Shu swordsmith.

The blade features a flaming pattern resembling a mountain range, with the peaks highlighted in white—akin to frozen summits. Thus, it bears the name Cloudfrost's Edge.

Bai Tingzhao received this sword from the nobles while serving as the town mayor, and it has since become a treasured heirloom of the Bai family.

10020.name: Flamebringer
10020.des:
A weapon forged by the Taoists of Zhenwu Temple to quell demons. It later fell into the hands of rebels who looted the temple.

The thick blade houses a mechanism that allows liquid flames to flow along its grooves and burst into life upon striking, incinerating everything it touches. 

By using Temperance to heat the blade further, the flames can unleash gouts of fire to scorch nearby enemies.

10040.name: Steel Fang
10040.des:
A new blade fashioned with a katana as inspiration.

Once quenched, a plethora of patterns appear upon the flat blade. The handle is lightweight and just as good as the original blade's.

Featuring a long slender blade, its wielder may keep their distance only to strike at the speed of light when the opportunity arises.

10060.name: Serpent Fang
10060.des:
Li Dingguo's blade, gifted by a tribal chieftain during their visit to the rebels.

The spine is coated in red mercury, while the handle bears a gilded pattern forged using an ancient method.

The serpent is said to transform into a dragon after a thousand years. Yet, the loyal servant seeks no transcendence.

10080.name: Lashing Whip
10080.des:
A relic left behind by the Shu ancients in the Shu Sanctum.

Once shattered, it was reforged and strung together in segments, allowing it to extend and strike like a whip.

With its weapon skill and unique attacks, it's able to transform from a sword into an iron whip to gain greater range.

10100.name: Moonlight Dragon
10100.des:
A blade the rebels acquired while plundering the Tang Emperor's Palace, the hilt of which features a jade carved into a dragon's mouth.

The spine has been specially treated to resemble dragonscale patterns, greatly enhancing its durability and strength.

Legend has it this sword's radiant light outshone the brilliance of the moon itself, earning it the name Moonlight Dragon.

10120.name: Swanblade
10120.des:
A long blade wrapped in feathers, pale tendrils coiling along its length like living veins. Within them flows the pure power of the Avians.

When roused, its feathers burst outward, striking like living things and detonating in violent blasts.

Only a master of magic can hope to wield it.

10300.name: Li Jiao's Fang
10300.des:
One of the most well-known weapons of the pirate Li Jiao.

Li Jiao gained notoriety due to her powerful and deadly weapons. Her whereabouts have remained unknown ever since she was defeated by Wuchang. Having learned of her legend, a weaponsmith forged this imitation and named it after her.

Enables you to control the pace of combat when used well.

10320.name: Halberd
10320.des:
A heavy weapon used by the Ming dynasty's troops against the pirates invading from the southern archipelago. Commonly wielded by large brutish soldiers.

A basic heavy weapon that leaves the enemy little breathing room. Each blow is fueled by lethal force, yet requires outstanding physique and power to wield properly.

10340.name: Scorn Greataxe
10340.des:
An exotic weapon from the southern archipelago, confiscated and reworked by the imperial court before being repurposed for military use.

The blade head is shrouded in flames and creates explosions when coming into contact with oily red mercury.

It was then used to sweep away marauding pirates, restore peace, and safeguard the common folk.

10360.name: Cinder Dragoncoil
10360.des:
Crafted from a blueprint originating from the southern archipelago, that Zhenwu Temple obtained through maritime trade. Pulling the trigger causes flames to burst forth like a roaring dragon. Hence its name: Cinder Dragoncoil.

Those who can manage its great weight and remain unfazed by enemy attacks can unleash its full power, causing utter devastation.

10380.name: Empyrean Greataxe
10380.des:
Recrafted from a standard Greataxe, this weapon was forged by Zhenwu Temple to vanquish demons.

A gunpowder device embedded in the handle detonates, launching the wielder into the air to execute a mighty strike. This is reminiscent of an empyrean descending with overwhelming force.

10400.name: Vermillion War Club
10400.des:
A weapon forged by the Taoists of Zhenwu Temple to quell demons. The blades, shaped in the form of pheasants, represent harmony and peace.

Etched with mystical symbols, the handle houses a hidden mechanism that releases a cloud of dust, causing Poise Break.

The pheasants are intricately designed in the likeness of the Vermillion Bird, a mythical beast symbolizing fire and rebirth. In times of strife, this weapon embodies the people's yearning for divine intervention to bring salvation.

10420.name: Redcoil Waraxe
10420.des:
A massive axe abandoned in the Avian Wars. Its shattered edge is bound and knotted with crimson sea lilies, making it heavier, tougher, and deadlier.

The blade can take on many forms to launch powerful attacks, enabling one to reach foes who think distance will save them.

10600.name: Thunder's Call
10600.des:
An exotic weapon from the southern archipelago, this blade boasts a distinctive shape and was crafted from a rare black ore.

Liu Wenxiu stumbled upon this weapon under mysterious circumstances, and conceived the idea of using it as a conduit for Zhenwu Temple's spells. After extensive study, he integrated it into his military arsenal, wielding it to channel thunder and lightning, leading to triumph in countless battles. 

By using Temperance to enhance the power of lightning, the weapon reaches unparalleled heights of might.

10620.name: Un-Equilibrium Blades
10620.des:
A pair of blades commissioned by the imperial court from a skilled swordsmith for the Imperial Guards.

Legends say that a master adept in wielding dual blades can deflect opponents' weapons with their swings, seamlessly blending offense and defense. However, ordinary warriors tend to fare better with a single blade.

10640.name: Twin Bandits
10640.des:
Crafted by Ming swordsmiths, these weapons blend the traits of scimitars and dual swords. They earned their name due to their resemblance to the weapons wielded by bandits.

While seemingly made for offense, they work equally great for defense. Forbearance enables one to truly tap into its power.

10680.name: Firearm Blades
10680.des:
An exotic weapon from the southern archipelago, confiscated and reworked by the imperial court before being repurposed for military use.

Though primarily a melee weapon, it also allows for launching attacks against distant enemies. Projectiles that hit will detonate after a short delay, making it a truly remarkable invention.

10700.name: Bitter Severance
10700.des:
Shaped like scissors, these blades were once a wedding gift from Huang Yan to her son, only to be repurposed as weapons in the end.

Designed for cutting fabric, their edges were razor-sharp. Split in two, they served just as well for cutting down villains and exacting revenge.

10720.name: Eternal Sovereignty
10720.des:
These exotic twin swords, with their unique and peculiar shape, were smuggled into Shu via the southern archipelago.

Revered as symbols of royal power, the curved blades are exceptionally sharp, excelling in both slicing and sweeping strikes with astonishing lethality.

The king who commissioned their forging dreamed of an eternal dynasty, but royal power is fleeting, easily lost to the ravages of time.

10740.name: Blazing Nightlotus
10740.des:
A weapon forged by the Taoists of Zhenwu Temple to quell demons.

Each hammerhead hides gunpowder. Strike them together and the lotus-shaped petals burst open, scattering powder that ignites instantly from the sparks of impact, unleashing a sudden explosion.

Only the most skilled warriors can master their fearsome, precise power.

11200.name: Darkfrost Edge
11200.des:
A weapon wielded by the Taoists of Zhenwu Temple, ideal for those who favor magic in combat.

The blade is thin, meticulously crafted for durability.
A Taoist lost his life while facing a demon, abandoning the sword, later uncovered by tomb robbers.

This weapon, merging strength and agility, requires swift movements to outmaneuver foes while silently building power for the next attack.

11220.name: Astral Blade
11220.des:
A peachwood blade from Zhenwu Temple. The blade is engraved with the Big Dipper, bolstering one's magical powers.

While of limited use in close-quarters combat, its true power hails from the Taoist belief that they must exorcise all of demonkind.

11240.name: Plumed Grace
11240.des:
This ancient blade, infused with the power of Bieling, was taken by Xuanyangzi from the Forbidden Lands.

Made of bronze, the sword features intricate tendrils that coil along its surface, while a fierce eyeball is engraved in the center, staring defiantly at the world.

Inspired by the Omnipotent Eye, Xuanyangzi recognized that the lives of ordinary people cannot bear the weight of infinite knowledge. Those who attempt to seize power from others will ultimately face a reckoning.

11260.name: Zhanlu Sword
11260.des:
This ancient blade was forged by the master swordsmith Ou Yezi.

Once a symbol of benevolence, Zhanlu fell into the hands of those with wicked intentions amid the world's turmoil. Its blade, eroded by malevolence, now bears a striking flame-like pattern. However, fate intervened, and the sword was drawn to Nian Suichang, whose kind heart radiated benevolence. They say that a hero of exceptional martial skill wielding the perfect weapon can face any adversary.

11280.name: Watcher's Gaze
11280.des:
A weapon of mysterious origin, imbued with ancient power.
It is said to have once belonged to the avians of Duryal's bloodline, with a faint trace of the Primordial Deity's essence still clinging to its form.

Around the crystal blade, red sea lilies twist and curl.
A blue-purple light gleams from the hilt, resembling a watchful eye that bridges the known and the unknown. Gazing upon it offers a glimpse into the infinite, bestowing boundless knowledge.

11500.name: Red-Tasseled Spear
11500.des:
This weapon, often wielded by militia, features a tip adorned with red tassels.

Its long, thick handle ensures ease of use. In skilled hands, a spear can triumph over any foe.

11520.name: Steampowered Spear
11520.des:
A weapon forged by the Taoists of Zhenwu Temple to quell demons. The whereabouts of this unique spear were lost after the looting of the temple.

With its weapon skill and unique attacks, it can transform into a haft to strike at faraway enemies.

If wielded skillfully, you can force enemies to spin in place, creating a chance to unleash a fierce attack.

11560.name: Malice Sting
11560.des:
A sharp silver long spear housing a clever internal mechanism.

When activated, the spearhead fills with venom, inflicting Blight damage upon foes.

This spear was a gift from grateful subordinates to a benevolent veteran, crafted as a token of their admiration. Yet, the veteran never wielded it, and after millennia of wandering, the one who offered the spear has long turned to dust, resting as withered bones beneath an unmarked mound.

11580.name: Cloudpiercer
11580.des:
Crafted from a blueprint originating from the southern archipelago, that Zhenwu Temple obtained through maritime trade.

The spearhead and body are linked by a sophisticated mechanism. Once ignited, the gunpowder inside detonates, delivering a tremendous impact that penetrates deep into the enemy's flesh.

Despite its incredible power, this weapon is challenging to wield and demands precise timing for effective use.

11600.name: Gunpowder Spear
11600.des:
An exotic weapon from the southern archipelago.

A gunpowder device, designed for multiple firings, has been affixed to the spear. It harnesses flames to rotate the mechanism, allowing for a series of rapid but low-accuracy shots.

The saying goes, "An inch for an inch" but this spear can reach targets a hundred feet away!

11620.name: Dragoncoil Lance
11620.des:
A sleek, silver-white spear with a razor-sharp edge, its design exudes simplicity and timeless craftsmanship.

Its handle is adorned with a coiled dragon, symbolizing the courage and bravery of its wielder.

Once wielded by a renowned general of the old world, the weapon has mysteriously resurfaced after centuries.

11640.name: Hooked Blade Spear
11640.des:
A long spear forged from fine iron, its lower blade fitted with barbs and a hooked iron ring.

It can pierce armor, shatter defenses, or hook and disarm foes. Its cunning design demands great skill, so few ever master it.

11800.name: Boreal Abyss
11800.des:
A weapon forged by a legendary Shu swordsmith. The Madam of Snowfall searched for and added it to her collection.

Its design is slender, with a wickedly sharp edge. The blade's surface is intricately marked with folded, forged patterns. Made from froststeel, it's not only perfect for close combat but also allows the wielder to send icy blades toward distant foes.

Its form is as elegant as a swan in flight, yet as fierce as a dragon in pursuit.

Even as red mercury consumed him, Lu Bingzhang clung to his dream of restoring Shu's former glory. His devotion first drew the Magus's whispers, and in the end, it bound him to the Feathering's.

18034.name: Clerical Waist Cloth

Even as red mercury consumed him, Lu Bingzhang clung to his dream of restoring Shu's former glory. His devotion first drew the Magus's whispers, and in the end, it bound him to the Feathering's.

Supposedly Wuchang's black attire.

The black and white Wuchang forms, appearing in twine, are responsible for guiding the souls of the deceased to the underworld. However, when the soul is that of a demon, Wuchang shows no hesitation in capturing it.

In Shu, those who have committed grave sins live in constant fear of her avatar of darkness.

The Black Wuchang brings misfortune to the wicked, while the White Wuchang bestows good fortune and wealth upon the virtuous.

18582.name: White Spectre
18582.des:
This attire embodies the benevolence of Wuchang's heart. The headpiece is crowned with an inscription reading "Wealth at First Sight."

The white and black Wuchang attires represent the profound balance of Yin and Yang—white symbolizing virtue and goodness, while black embodies malice and darkness. Those with pure hearts who gaze upon the white Wuchang are said to be blessed with good fortune and prosperity.

18592.name: Night Spectre
18592.des:
This attire manifests the malice within Wuchang's heart. The headpiece is crowned with an inscription reading "Peace Reigns the Land."

The white and black Wuchang attires represent the profound balance of Yin and Yang—white symbolizing virtue and goodness, while black embodies malice and darkness. Those with impure intentions who encounter the black Wuchang may find themselves meeting a grim fate.

18601.name: Draconic Resurgence - Crown
18601.des:
A crown adorned with coral-shaped crystals resembling a dragon's horn, radiating divine light.

The common people divide the stars into four symbols, with the Azure Dragon being one of them. Representing life and revival, it is deeply revered.

18602.name: Draconic Resurgence - Robe
18602.des:
A silk robe crafted from fine azure silk, adorned with golden thread embroidery as elegant as a swimming dragon.

In the Shu region, long afflicted by the Feathering, its people long for a sweet rain to purify the land of evil spirits and disease.

18603.name: Draconic Resurgence - Bracers
18603.des:
Bracers covered in fine scales as if several small dragons were entwined around them.

In the Shu region, long afflicted by the Feathering, its people long for a sweet rain to purify the land of evil spirits and disease.

18604.name: Draconic Resurgence - Long Boots
18604.des:
Long boots crafted from deep-sea gemstones, their lustrous surfaces enabling effortless traversal across mountains and rivers.

In the Shu region, long afflicted by the Feathering, its people long for a sweet rain to purify the land of evil spirits and disease.

18611.name: Overlord's Regalia - Hairpin
18611.des:
A hairpin crafted from precious gold that, once nestled into the hair as an ornament, serves as a display of the wearer's wealth and high status.

Elegant yet practical, it quickly became a favored accessory among pirates.

18612.name: Overlord's Regalia - Coat
18612.des:
A coat woven from exquisite silk and golden thread that serves as a display of the wearer's wealth and high status.

Adorned with swirling clouds and soaring feathers, its intricate patterns captured the imagination, soon giving rise to the set's legendary name—the Overlord's Regalia.

18613.name: Overlord's Regalia - Bracers
18613.des:
Bracers crafted from a blend of leather and gold jewelry that serve as a display of the wearer's wealth and high status.

Adorned with swirling clouds and soaring feathers, its intricate patterns captured the imagination, soon giving rise to the set's legendary name—the Overlord's Regalia.

18614.name: Overlord's Regalia - Long Boots
18614.des:
Long boots made from supple leather, designed for a perfect fit and lightweight for ease of movement in combat.

Elegant yet practical, they quickly became a favorite among pirates.

18622.name: Obsession's Armor
18622.des:
Chest armor fashioned from white cloth, so worn by battle that its original form can no longer be discerned.

Cause and effect flow in an endless cycle, like the unbroken turn of a wheel. The so-called "inner demon" is but the lingering mark of those ensnared in reincarnation, unable to break free.

18623.name: Obsession's Wrist Wraps
18623.des:
Wrist wraps of white cloth, so worn by battle that their original form can no longer be discerned.

Even after a thousand journeys through endless dreams, she never let go of her obsession—reviving Bai Yu.

18624.name: Obsession's Shin Wraps
18624.des:
Shin wraps of white cloth, so worn by battle that their original form can no longer be discerned.

Even after a thousand journeys through endless dreams, she never let go of her obsession—reviving Bai Yu.

18641.name: Bo Sorcerer's Crown
18641.des:
A bronze crown worn by the Bo Sorcerer. Legend says it serves as a conduit for communication with the gods.

Only those chosen as a Sorcerer may wear it, and through it, they can hear the guidance of the Divine.

18651.name: Forged Iron High Helm
18651.des:
A sturdy and meticulously crafted ancient helm, made from bent iron strips. Its reinforced neck guard works with the armored collar to deflect blades and arrows.

The tall crest bristles with red silk tassels, blazing like a banner across the battlefield.

18652.name: Forged Iron Breastplate
18652.des:
A sturdy and meticulously crafted ancient chestplate, layered with overlapping plates that gleam like fish scales.

The high iron collar protects the neck, while a crimson cloak draped over the shoulders gives the wearer a commanding presence.

18653.name: Forged Iron Armguards
18653.des:
Sturdy and meticulously crafted ancient armguards extending from wrist to elbow.

Leather lining keeps them snug, shielding one's arms from enemy blows.

18654.name: Forged Iron Leg Guards
18654.des:
Sturdy and meticulously crafted ancient leg guards that stretch from knee to ankle.

Leather lining holds them tight, guarding the legs against enemy strikes.

18661.name: Radiant Dawnfeather Helm
18661.des:
A commanding helm crowned with phoenix plumes. Even at rest, it lends its wearer an aura of unshakable authority.

Forged for generals, it embodies both rank and resolve. An emblem of power that cows enemies before the battle even begins.

18662.name: Radiant Armor
18662.des:
A masterwork armor of iron, chased with snarling beasts and guarded by a round heart-plate. Its weight and craft make it all but unyielding.

Forged for generals, it embodies both rank and resolve. An emblem of power that cows enemies before the battle even begins.

18663.name: Radiant Vambraces
18663.des:
Polished bracers of layered steel, bright enough to catch the eye and firm enough to turn aside blade or arrow.

Backed with leather for a soldier's grip, they guard as well as they intimidate.

18664.name: Radiant Leg Guards
18664.des:
Polished greaves of layered steel, gleaming like mirrors with every step. Beast-head designs snarl from the toes of the boots.

Backed with leather, they hold firm in battle, shielding the legs while striking fear into foes.

18681.name: Jadeborn Grace
18681.des:
A hairpin of sea lily branches that glimmers with a faint golden light. Nourished by Feathering, it sprouted crystalline growths.

The people, mistaking myth for form, named it so: hair fine as cicada wings, jade cold as autumn water.

18691.name: Draconic Duskdance: Hairpin
18691.des:
A jade ornament embedded with gems used to gather the hair for battle.

Jade, long a symbol of restraint and virtue, lends its quiet strength to the wearer.

18692.name: Draconic Duskdance: Garb
18692.des:
Cloth robes of deep black fashioned out of soft fabric, their luster dark and muted.

They declare nothing, yet their silence carries an austere authority.

18694.name: Draconic Duskdance: Boots
18694.des:
Black boots, firm in stitch and high in curve, built for long marches across weary miles.

While light, they endure without falter, as if burdened with a solemn vow.

18702.name: Draconic Duskdance: Mantle
18702.des:
A dark cloak of heavy weave fashioned out of soft fabric, its luster dark and muted.

It shields against bitter winds, and lends its bearer a grave and commanding presence.

18711.name: Draconic Dawndance: Hairpin
18711.des:
A jade ornament embedded with gems used to gather the hair for battle.

Jade, long a symbol of restraint and virtue, lends its quiet strength to the wearer.

18712.name: Draconic Dawndance: Garb
18712.des:
Cloth robes of pure white fashioned out of soft fabric that shine like the full moon.

They declare nothing, yet their silence carries an austere authority.

18714.name: Draconic Dawndance: Boots
18714.des:
Black boots, firm in stitch and high in curve, built for long marches across weary miles.

While light, they endure without falter, as if burdened with a solemn vow.

18722.name: Draconic Dawndance: Mantle
18722.des:
Cloth robes of pure white fashioned out of soft fabric that shine like the full moon.

Though offering little warmth, it veils one's form in austere dignity.

18732.name: Duskhaze Bamboo
18732.des:
A robe woven with golden threads, faintly shimmering with light. Intricate embroidery traces a variety of patterns, adding to its refined and elegant charm.

With each step, the hem sways like bamboo in evening haze, equally serene, steadfast, and unbowed.

18741.name: Wide-Brimmed Hat
18741.des:
A wide-brimmed hat with an open top, topped with a jewel. The ornament serves a ceremonial purpose, while the brim protects from sun and rain.

Thanks to its versatile design, this hat is seen both in daily life and in formal, ceremonial settings.

18751.name: Black Traditional Hat
18751.des:
A round-topped ceremonial hat with a tall rear piece. The frame is woven from iron and copper wire and draped in black mesh.

Its elegant and stately design is traditionally worn by those who wish to convey dignity, poise, and proper ceremonial decorum.

25000.name: Crescent Arc
25000.des:
Step backward to quickly distance yourself from the enemy and avoid damage.
Use at the opportune time to trigger <skilly>[Shimmer]</>.
Use with <skilly>[Skyborn Might]</> for greater potency.
<skilly>[Shimmer]</>: Evade at the opportune time to avoid the enemy's attack fully.

25001.name: Corrosive Flurry
25001.des:
Strike with speed and precision.
While rapid strikes can knock most foes back, they lack the power to be truly lethal to Feathered creatures.
Use with <skilly>[Skyborn Might]</> for greater potency, causing Corruption buildup.

25004.name: Dash Strike
25004.des: This move requires you to utilize your entire body to launch a swift slash, making it a handy escape tool when facing a group of enemies.

25005.name: Crescent Moon
25005.des:
Slash in a spiral to close in, then use again to leap backward and create some distance from the enemy.
Time the backward leap right to also trigger <skilly>[Shimmer]</>.
Use with <skilly>[Skyborn Might]</> for greater potency.
<skilly>[Shimmer]</>: Evade at the opportune time to avoid the enemy's attack fully.

25006.name: Sword Counter
25006.des:
Raise your blade to block the enemy's attack.
Block at the perfect moment to <skilly>[Deflect]</> the attack instead.
<skilly>[Deflect]</>: Blocking the enemy's <skilly>weapon</> at the perfect time deflects the enemy's move fully.

25100.name: Colossal Smash
25100.des:
Raise your axe high before bringing it crashing down.
Use with <skilly>[Skyborn Might]</> to create a morass of red mercury, causing Corruption buildup to enemies within it.

25101.name: Rampage
25101.des:
A technique favored by pirates in close-quarters combat, relying on the axe's natural heft to deliver powerful cleaves.
Use with <skilly>[Skyborn Might]</> for greater potency.

25102.name: Earthshatter
25102.des:
Pound your axe into the ground, splitting the very earth to create a powerful shockwave that knocks enemies back.
Use with <skilly>[Skyborn Might]</> to bolster your <skilly>[Resilience]</>.
<skilly>[Resilience]</>: Renders your attacks more difficult to interrupt.

25103.name: Whirlwind
25103.des:
Turn with great force as you swing your mighty axe, finishing with a final massive strike.
Even heavily armored foes will find this move difficult to face.
Use with <skilly>[Skyborn Might]</> for greater potency.

25104.name: Block
25104.des:
Raise your axe to defend against enemy attacks.
Greatly reduces the damage of enemy attacks.

25201.name: Blademaster
25201.des:
Cross your blades before you and seek to become one with the void, for only then may you tap into the powers of <skilly>[Bladeborn]</>.
Use with <skilly>[Skyborn Might]</> to gain the <skilly>[Bladeborn]</> buff.
Performing a successful <skilly>[Clash]</> during <skilly>[Bladeborn]</> restores some health.
<skilly>[Bladeborn]</> makes your Dual Blades light attacks even swifter.

25202.name: Blade Dance
25202.des:
Revolve and launch a flurry of strikes with both blades.
Relying on one's flexibility, this move is beautiful and deadly in equal measure.
Use with <skilly>[Skyborn Might]</> for greater potency.

25203.name: Whirling Flurry
25203.des:
Spin swiftly and strike with both blades.
Used when the enemy is Vulnerable, this move unleashes high damage in a short burst.
Use with <skilly>[Skyborn Might]</> for greater potency.

25204.name: Shadow Lunge
25204.des:
Brandish your blades in a quick forward lunge, then follow up with a powerful thrust.
Great for capitalizing on short gaps in the enemy's defenses.
Use with <skilly>[Skyborn Might]</> for greater potency.

25300.name: Spinning Kick
25300.des:
Leap forward and kick the enemy with great force.
Pirates will seek to attain victory by any means necessary.
Use with <skilly>[Skyborn Might]</> for greater potency.

25305.name: Vanguard Breaker
25305.des:
Summon all your strength for a powerful forward thrust.
A secret technique perfected by Zhenwu Temple.
Use with <skilly>[Skyborn Might]</> for greater potency, also inflicting Poise Break buildup on the enemy.

25306.name: Swift Lunge
25306.des:
Focus your being and launch a thrust attack.
Speed is oft crucial to victory, and being able to strike the enemy before they can react gives you the upper hand.
Use with <skilly>[Skyborn Might]</> for greater potency.

25307.name: Slicing Zephyr
25307.des:
Soar on the air current,
charge forward while spinning, and strike all around you.
Then, harness your momentum to deliver a powerful sweeping slash
(has the <skilly>[Clash]</> effect).
Use with <skilly>[Skyborn Might]</> for greater potency.

25308.name: Flickering Blade
25308.des:
Brandish your sword with lightning speed to weaken the enemy's attack.
Grants partial immunity to damage but does not block all incoming attacks.
Known for its agility, One-Handed Swords enable a steady, seamless rhythm when this technique is used well.
Use with <skilly>[Skyborn Might]</> for greater potency.

25400.name: Upward Force
25400.des:
Let your body guide the spear, driving it upward with a powerful strike that can send enemies flying.
Converts your <skilly>[Boldheart]</> stacks into <skilly>[Skyborn Might]</> stacks on hit.
Use with <skilly>[Skyborn Might]</> for greater potency.

25403.name: Furious Stab
25403.des:
While stationed in Shu, the Ming army trained its soldiers rigorously in this skill.
Grab your spear with both hands and stab multiple times in quick succession, only to launch a final lethal strike.
Converts your <skilly>[Boldheart]</> stacks into <skilly>[Skyborn Might]</> stacks on hit.
Use with <skilly>[Skyborn Might]</> for greater potency.

25405.name: Spear Flurry
25405.des:
Swing your spear in a wide arc, striking all enemies in your path
(has the <skilly>[Clash]</> effect).
<skilly>[Clash]</>: Clash <skilly>weapons</> with your enemy, deflecting incoming damage.

25407.name: Solar Leap
25407.des:
Leap forward with great force to strike a fierce blow.
Converts your <skilly>[Boldheart]</> stacks into <skilly>[Skyborn Might]</> stacks on hit.
Enables you to close the distance to the enemy, giving you the ability to strike first.
Use with <skilly>[Skyborn Might]</> for greater potency.

25408.name: Aerial Bulwark
25408.des:
Gain <skilly>[Fleetness]</> while charging <skills>Aerial Bulwark</>.
When used as the enemy strikes, you can evade attacks and launch a counter.
Use with <skilly>[Skyborn Might]</> for greater potency.
<skilly>[Fleetness]</>: <skilly>[Fleetness]</> allows you to dodge a single enemy attack.

25409.name: Spearveil
25409.des:
<skilly>Spearveil</> now grants you <skilly>[Fleetness]</> for a time.
Leap back to create distance while gripping your spear firmly.
Skillful use allows for a swift counterattack.
Use with <skilly>[Skyborn Might]</> for greater potency.
<skilly>[Fleetness]</>: <skilly>[Fleetness]</> allows you to dodge a single enemy attack.

30000.name: Blink Kick

Drop down low to launch a fierce kick.
It works wonders in narrow spaces, where other moves might be difficult to carry out.
Use with <skilly>[Skyborn Might]</> for greater potency.

Strike while revolving and advance forward.
While weak against armored foes, a rapid torrent of strikes is great for taking the enemy by surprise.
Use with <skilly>[Skyborn Might]</> for greater potency.
